question: Among living patients whose last names begin with "A" and who each have exactly one distinct condition, which eight conditions have the highest number of different active medications prescribed to any single patient, and what are their corresponding codes?
sql:
WITH living_a_patients AS (
  SELECT 
    p.id as patient_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.patient` p
  JOIN UNNEST(p.name) as n
  WHERE p.deceased.dateTime IS NULL
    AND n.family LIKE 'A%'
),
patient_condition_count AS (
  SELECT 
    lap.patient_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.code.coding[OFFSET(0)].code) as num_conditions
  FROM living_a_patients lap
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.condition` c ON c.subject.patientId = lap.patient_id
  GROUP BY lap.patient_id
),
single_condition_patients AS (
  SELECT patient_id
  FROM patient_condition_count
  WHERE num_conditions = 1
),
patient_condition_map AS (
  SELECT 
    sc.patient_id,
    c.code.coding[OFFSET(0)].code as condition_code,
    c.code.coding[OFFSET(0)].display as condition_display
  FROM single_condition_patients sc
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.condition` c ON c.subject.patientId = sc.patient_id
),
patient_med_count AS (
  SELECT 
    pcm.patient_id,
    pcm.condition_code,
    pcm.condition_display,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mr.medication.codeableConcept.coding[OFFSET(0)].code) as num_active_meds
  FROM patient_condition_map pcm
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.medication_request` mr 
    ON mr.subject.patientId = pcm.patient_id
    AND mr.status = 'active'
  WHERE mr.medication.codeableConcept.coding IS NOT NULL
    AND mr.medication.codeableConcept.coding[OFFSET(0)].code IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY pcm.patient_id, pcm.condition_code, pcm.condition_display
)
SELECT condition_code, condition_display, MAX(num_active_meds) as max_meds
FROM patient_med_count
GROUP BY condition_code, condition_display
ORDER BY max_meds DESC, condition_code ASC
LIMIT 8
